items.verse: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.

items.verse: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُۥ سَلَـٰمٌۭ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًۭا كَرِيمًۭا
items.verseEn: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.

items.verse: قَالَتْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَـٰبٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
items.verseEn: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.

categories.name: أحداث يوم القيامة في سورة القيامة
categories.nameEn: Events of the Day of Judgment in Surah Al-Qiyamah

items.verseEn: And the sun and the moon are joined,
To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

items.verse: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
items.verseEn: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتُ قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْقَرْيَةِ فِي سُورَةِ يس
categories.nameEn: Vocabulary from the Story of the People of the Lost Town in Surah Ya-Sin

items.verse: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
items.verseEn: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

items.verse: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
items.verseEn: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

items.verse: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
items.verseEn: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

categories.name: أَوَامِرُ التَّبْلِيغِ لِلنَّبِيِّ
categories.nameEn: Commands to the Prophet to Proclaim

items.verse: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.verseEn: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.

items.verse: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
items.verseEn: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

harf.hint: A mental faculty whose absence causes regret on the Day of Judgment — the disbelievers wish they had employed it alongside listening
harf.arabicVerse: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
harf.verse: 67:10 - And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

deduction.title: The Watchful Soul by the Riverbank
deduction.intro: A young soul was entrusted with a secret mission, to observe from a safe distance as destiny unfolded on the waters. Unseen and unsuspected, this figure would play a pivotal role in altering the course of a nation's history.
clues: I was given a task by my mother, one that required stealth and vigilance.
My eyes followed a small cradle drifting along the current, my heart heavy with worry.
When it was found by an unexpected party, I drew near, full of trepidation.
I saw their desperation for a caretaker and offered a solution without revealing the truth.
My timely intervention brought a nursing soul back to the one who needed it most.
In the courts of the powerful, I spoke: 'Shall I direct you to a family who will nourish him and look after him with care?'

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: The throwing of a child into the river
trial.answer: The throwing of a child into the river

outcome.label: Outcome
options: She reunited the child with his mother
She saved herself from Pharaoh's soldiers
outcome.answer: She reunited the child with his mother

deduction.arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
deduction.verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)

translations: And when said your Lord to the angels Indeed, I (am) going to place
in the earth a vicegerent they said Will You place in it
(one) who will spread corruption in it and will shed [the] blood[s] while we
[we] glorify (You) with Your praises and we sanctify [to] You He said
Indeed, I [I] know what not you know
scramble.hint: This verse marks Allah's announcement to the angels about creating a khalifa (vicegerent) on Earth, relating to the creation of Prophet Adam and humanity's role as stewards of the earth.
scramble.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
words: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌۭ
فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا
مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ
scramble.verseEn: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?" He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."
